top_categories.workout_context: Road-specific control matters at Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo. Practice on paved mountain roads: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 73 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
10,826ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
147ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
10,826ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo. Train it until it feels boring.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
73 miles on paved mountain roads burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
Base fitness for Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,826ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on paved mountain roads can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo's 73 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo includes meaningful altitude exposure. Reduced oxygen availability can affect sustainable power, pacing, and recovery. Use a conservative upper-mountain pacing plan, test any travel or acclimatization strategy before the event, and plan layers for changing conditions. Do not begin iron or other supplements without clinician-guided testing.
race_overlay.terrain: The technical descents at Sierra Nevada Límite Gran Fondo demand practice on similar paved roads. Ride paved mountain roads at race-day cadence weekly. Practice braking points, corner entry, line choice, and accelerating smoothly out of turns. Confirm tire pressure and equipment before race week.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 73 miles of paved mountain roads in Cenes de la Vega, Granada, Spain.
